assets.title: Three-tier Shuttle Cradle Rack
assets.description: One original empty static three-tier weaving-shuttle cradle rack. Two thick chamfer-crowned side uprights stand on two finite flat feet and are tied by two narrow rear crossbeams. Six separate continuous thick U-section cradles form three opposed pairs. Each pair supports the two underside end regions of a single long shuttle; the broad centre remains truly empty rather than a solid shelf. Each cradle has a continuous 12 mm floor and distinct low front and rear lips with genuine open recesses. All three shuttle spaces are empty in this asset. Original numerical cradle and frame geometry, not a reduced spool rack or drying tray. Twelve named closed editable meshes, three opaque constant PBR materials, metres, source Z up, front -Y and ground-centre origin. No texture nodes or linked material inputs. An unchanged fixed earlier shuttle is used externally for three rigid-translation QA placements only, never added to this generator, native asset, GLB, formal images or prop count. Only the explicitly tested fixed positions of that exact version are described; no universal shuttle or loom compatibility, insertion or removal trajectory, movement, clamping, weaving, storage capacity, hand fit, material, load, strength, anti-tip, manufacturing, installation or safety performance is claimed.
